metadata.name: RISE Motordrome — Short layout
metadata.description: Anticlockwise 5.34 km circuit with 14 corners beside Lake Kidogo at Bugesera, the short lap: the link road cuts out the loop over the ridge. My reading of the official design from its published renders and figures, set on the site's real ground: plateau pit straight, the banked Bowl, the long descent to the West Hill hairpin and the esses along the lake. 72 m elevation range, 174 m climbed per lap.
